purpose: Fresh source-only audit and execution-integrity fixtures; consistency tooling, not actual production provenance.

r2.staleness: Current gate/test bytes passed 133 tests; earlier first/R1 outcomes remain separate.

lessons.observation: Two new raw-stream fixtures accidentally used literal backslash-n separators; first run 125/127 failed at malformed JSON instead of the intended start/terminal check.
lessons.prevention: Construct streams using json.dumps per native event plus an actual newline; assert the intended rejection reason and preserve first fixture bytes.

lessons.observation: An extra raw test start absent from JUnit had no missing-terminal check.
lessons.prevention: Require every raw started test to reach a terminal, including tests outside the XML, while keeping ignored terminal semantics explicit.
lessons.validation: R2 full suite passed 133/133, including all six source-audit regressions.

lessons.observation: Source audit found disjoint passing partitions could combine different revisions if they declared no exclusions.
lessons.prevention: Require one exact common source-manifest hash across the entire suite; retained executable identities may differ only for disjoint native targets.
lessons.validation: R2 full suite passed 133/133, including all six source-audit regressions.

lessons.observation: A negative process return code could qualify as expected assertion failure after some raw failure events.
lessons.prevention: Classify signal termination as a harness error. Require exact failed-ID/raw-event-bound behavioral triage, and manually verify the actual assertion cause.
lessons.validation: R2 full suite passed 133/133, including all six source-audit regressions.

lessons.observation: Raw reports and hashes establish internal consistency, not authenticity of discovery, process exits, or the truth of behavioral triage.
lessons.prevention: Keep production provenance explicitly unverified and retain trusted native-runner command, binary identity and raw outputs separately.

lessons.observation: A live thermal watcher does not by itself prove successful attachment, quota application or sensor sampling.
lessons.prevention: Before workload, verify attachment/quota/safe sample and inspect actual owned-container quota; supervise watcher liveness independently during work, fail closed on early exit and persist first outcomes before cleanup.
lessons.validation: Kite first native holdout passed 5/5 with readiness evidence and independently supervised .25 CPU/1s guard. No injected fault probe was performed.

lessons.observation: The source snapshot does not by itself invalidate timestamp-based Cargo caches after restoring mutants.
lessons.prevention: Refresh affected source mtimes, record rebuild evidence and executable hashes, and set RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP only on the native libtest process.

lessons.observation: Kite native first run passed 5/5, but a root-owned nested report directory rejected the host gate output, and the launcher did not propagate that failed gate.
lessons.prevention: Precreate nested host evidence directories, write host reports to a known writable path, and propagate nonzero gate status after preserving native results. Recover reporting from unchanged raw bytes without rerunning passing tests.

lessons.observation: Parent reported Parquet coverage at verified 0.25 CPU / 1s had 15 brief pauses and a peak of 84°C with no competing compiler seen; the same worker changed to 0.1 CPU at 2026-09-12T23:15:01Z, and the following two minutes peaked at 74°C with no pauses.
lessons.prevention: Treat quota as tunable, not a thermal guarantee. Preserve first overshoot and raw samples, quota-change timestamp, independent guard supervision and separate timings by quota.
lessons.provenance: Parent-supplied current workload observation; not independently rerun or a controlled performance comparison.

thermal_validation: No thermal unit module existed in the discovered Python suite. Prior isolated Docker guard probes belong to their original evidence; none were repeated here.
scope: No paid checks, no production provenance claim, no change to current task budget override or normal default restoration.

ra_final_lesson.source: Parent supplied R3 final metrics; independent current-gate combined reconciliation performed here. Source implementation and archived solutions were not inspected for this integration.
ra_final_lesson.remaining_failure: Keyword-token fixture outside stated non-keyword identifier scope; native failure remains explicit.
history: R1 repair introduced an existing legacy completion regression.
R2 left two empty shorthand completion failures.
ra_final_lesson.prevention: After each holdout-driven production repair, rerun original existing regressions and fresh tests, not only failed holdouts. Preserve native out-of-contract failures separately and prove token scope instead of extending production behavior to force green.
